files.caption: George Hildreth House, 17 Jackson St., Cape May, New Jersey.  in the Cape May Historic District an NHL since 1976.  The HD is noted for its concentration of Victorian architecture.  This house represents a concentration within a concentration.  Numbers 17, 19, qnd 20 Jackson Street are all notable examples of Victorian architecture and have been documented by HABS
